summary: Insurance-led conglomerate. Since ASU 2016-01 forced unrealized equity gains through the income statement in 2018, GAAP net income mostly measures the stock market, not the business — Buffett explicitly tells shareholders to ignore it. Judge Berkshire on operating earnings (ex investment gains), growth in book value per share, and float.

Consolidated total debt therefore overstates holding-company leverage. The recourse/non-recourse split is disclosed only in 10-K text and segment tables, not in XBRL, so the app cannot compute the adjusted figure; read this line as consolidated, not parent-level.

Berkshire reports operating earnings separately and the app already extracts that figure from the 10-K text (brk_operating_earnings); use it rather than net income. Note a naive net income minus investment_gains does NOT reproduce it ($39.7B vs $47.4B), because the tagged investment_gains series captures only unrealized equity marks, not all investment gains.
